tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa'i bsdus don tshul gsum gsal rgyan zhes bya ba'i khog phub don 'grel pad dkar 'phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ /ji snyed chos kun gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa las/ /nam yang g.yo med ji lta'i dngos gcig pur/ /mnyam par bzhag nas zung 'jug ston mkhas pa/ /'khor lo'i mgon po rje btsun bla ma rgyal/ /dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs kyi gsung rab mchog /rgyud sde spyi yi rnam par bzhag pa yi/ /bsdus don tshul gsum gsal rgyan zhes bya ba'i/ /don 'grel pad dkar phreng mdzes 'dir spel lo/ /de la 'dir 'jam pa'i dbyangs mi'i sku gzugs can slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud sde spyi rnam chen mo'i don bsdus tshul gsum gsal rgyan zhes bya ba yongs 'dzin e waṃ pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos de nyid 'chad pa la/ don gsum ste/ klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don dang gsum/ dang po la mchod par brjod pa dang bshad pa dam bca' ba gnyis/ dang po la 'bras bu sku bzhi yon tan gyi sgo nas bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med pa la mchod par brjod pa/ srol 'byed kyi gtso bo la mchod par brjod pa/ srol 'dzin gyi gtso bo la mchod par brjod pa/ brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo la mchod par brjod pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ na maḥshrī tsakra nā tha ratna wardhā ya/ /srid gsum ro gcig rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag med zhal gyi bdud rtsi mtho ris klung / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ de las 'ong ba'i tshul chen dal 'gro'i rgyun/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ gang de'i yongs rdzogs chos kyi rgyal srid la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa bshad par dam bca' ba ni/ zab rgyas rgyud sde kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod/

/ces sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ tshul bzhi'i rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / tshul dang po gsum bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam gzhag mtshan gyi don dang bshad thabs dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la spyi'i rnam gzhag mtshan gyi don/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag dang gsum/ dang po la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ mjug bsdu/ skabs kyi mtshan smos pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ dang po la ni 'thob bya thob byed gnyis/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la dmigs par bya ba'i yul lam 'thob par bya ba 'bras bu'i rnam par gzhag pa dang / de thob par byed pas lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa gnyis/ dang po la mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dang / de gcig kho nar bsgrub pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'thob bya spangs rtogs mthar thug rdo rje'i sa/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ theg pa kun gyi gong ma de kho na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis bstan/ gnyis pa de thob par byed pa sa lam gyi rnam gzhag la/ lam rang gi ngo bo/ de'i rab tu dbye ba/ dbye ba so so'i rang bzhin/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las gsang sngags kyi theg pa khyad par du 'phags tshul/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsang sngags kyi theg pa nyid bye brag tu bshad pa dang lnga/ dang po la/ lam spyi'i mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rang 'thob bya'i 'bras bu la dmigs nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de la mtshan rtags dbye ba mang yod kyang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ thun mong ba'i lam dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ thun mongs ngan 'gro bde 'gro thar pa tsam/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa la lam thun mong ba bstan pa'i dgos pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin gnyis/ dang po ni/ sna tshogs gdul bya rjes su dkri ba dang /

/zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de lam thun mong ba las khyad par du 'phags tshul/ khyad par du 'phags pa de'i dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ kun mkhyen ma dmigs theg chen 'jug ngogs ni/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ lam 'og ma 'og ma las gong ma gong ma khyad par du 'phags tshul spyir bstan pa dang / theg dman las theg chen khyad par du 'phags tshul bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sdug bsngal spong dang srid la ma zhen dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ chos lnga rang bzhin gsum dang rnam shes brgyad/ /ces sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ theg pa che la lam gsum lam gcig las/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ /gnyis pa de'i rab tu dbye ba la/ dbye gzhi/ dbye ba'i don/ grangs nges pa/ ming gi don/ zhar byung rtsod spangs dang lnga/ dang po ni/ gzhan las phul byung theg pa chen po la/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye na pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags gnyis/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ de gnyis gdul bya dbang po rno rtul phyir/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ de phyir theg chen spyi dang sngags zhes grags/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa ni/ 'di dang mthar thug gcig tu bshad pa gnyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gsum pa dbye ba so so'i rang bzhin la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen rnam gnyis bzhi spong mi spong byed/ /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa la pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag dang / rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po la 'khor 'das thun mong ba'i gzhi gtan la dbab pa/ gzhi spong ba lam du byed pa'i tshul/ phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag lam des 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dus bstan pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi de 'khor 'das thun mong ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i tshul dang gnyis/

dang po ni/ gzhi sgra rgyu rkyen gnas dang kun sbyor dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de nyid thabs kyis dbye bas 'khor ba dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la yul gyi rang bzhin ma shes pas 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur tshul/ de'i rang bzhin shes pas mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyur 'gyur tshul/ des na yul nyid kyi 'ching grol gyi nus pa med par bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dang por yul myong de la mngon zhen skye/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ thog mar yul myong de yis rang bzhin shes/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ de phyir yul gyi steng na 'ching grol rgyu/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa gzhi spong ba lam du byed pa'i tshul la/ yul la mi mthun pa blta ba dang / de spong ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las dang nyon mongs las/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ tshul min yid byed sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gsum pa phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag la/ lam rang gi ngo bo'i rnam gzhag dang / lam de'i mngon par rtogs pa skye tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gro la snying rje chen pos kun bslangs nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen rigs dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gnyis kyis bstan/ /bzhi pa 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dus ni/ de nyid la rten brtson pa rab kyis kyang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag la/ gzhi mi spong ba'i tshul/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i rnam gzhag rdo rje theg pa'i rnam gzhag des 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dus bstan pa dang bzhi/ dang po la gzhi mi spong ba'i 'thad pa/

mi spong pa'i tshul dngos/ des grol ba'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ chags can thabs dang ldan pa'i gang zag la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ yul nyid 'ching bar byed pa ma yin kyang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ spang bya rim gyis spong zhing slar grogs byed/ /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ mtshan rtog skyob phyir de la sngags zhes bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du byin brlabs nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa de'i 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dus ni/ 'bras bu'i rnam pa bsgom dang 'bras bu la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las gsang sngags kyi theg pa khyad par du 'phags tshul la/ rtogs bya de kho na nyid cig par bstan pa/ rtogs byed kyi thabs khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul/ de la rtsod pa spang ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mdo sngags rnam gnyis rtogs bya chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i thabs ma rmongs pa dang / 'bras bu 'grub pa'i thabs mang ba dang / dka' ba med par bde bas byang chub sgrub pa dang / /'bras bu myur du 'grub pa'i phyir dbang po rno ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ phar phyin lam gyi so skye'i gnas skabs su/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang dgus bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ thun mong lam gyi thabs mkhas ji snyed pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ phar phyin nas bshad sgrub dka'i dka' spyad dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ skyon med sngags kyi thabs mkhas la brten pa'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa rtsod spangs ni/ 'di la sngon du gzhan gyis brgal ba'i tshul/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ lnga pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsang sngags kyi theg pa nyid bye brag tu bshad pa la/

rgyud sde'i rab tu dbye ba dang / gsang sngags theg pa'i byung tshul gnyis/ dang po la gsang sngags mtha' dag rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba/ bye brag tu rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud gtan la dbab pa/ rgyud sde rnams kyi tshad bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la rgyud sde bzhir grangs nges pa/ go rim nges pa/ ming gi don/ rtsod pa spang ba dang bzhi/ dang po la/ phyi rol mu stegs byed la log pa'i spyod pa bzhi yod pa'i de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rgyud sde bzhir dbye pa/ sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi theg pa la grub mtha' mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pas de dang lung sgo bstun gyi dbang du byas te lha'i skyed chog mi 'dra ba bzhis rgyud sde bzhir grangs nges pa/ 'dod khams kyi sems can la chags pa che 'bring bzhi yod pas de dag ma spangs kyang byang chub kyi lam yod par bstan pa'i phyir rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rig byed tshad mar 'dod pa'i mu stegs byed/ /ces sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rang bde gnas ma bu rnams phung po las/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bco lngas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ lta rgod 'khyud dang gnyis kyis gnyis sprad pas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa go rim nges pa ni/ dman 'bring mchog dang ches mchog gdul bya bzhis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa ming don ni/ lus ngag bya dang gnyis ka cha mnyam spyod/ /ces sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ bzhi pa rtsod spangs la/ rgyud sde gsum dang lnga dang drug tu bshad pa dang mi 'gal bar bstan pa dang / bzhir nges pa'i 'thad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bla med yo gar bsdus nas rgyud gsum du/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gang zag dbang dang lam bzhi'i gtan tshigs kyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa bye brag tu rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud gtan la dbab pa la/

thabs shes gnyis med gsum du dbye ba/ de gsum gyi khyad par/ khyad par de dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi rnam gzhag dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rnal 'byor che la thabs shes gnyis med gsum/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de yi khyad par gleng gzhi'i yi ge dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa la rgyud spyi'i nges tshul/ bye brag kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gtan la dbab pa gnyis/ dang po la rtsa bshad/ bzhugs tshul/ mdo rgyas/ gzhung tshad bstan pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rgyud gang sngon byung bshad gzhi rtsa rgyud de/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang dgus bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyud kun gzhi lam 'bras gsum bskyed rim dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ mdo rgyas tshig dang don gyi rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ sdeb sbyor tshigs bcad rkang bzhi par nges kyang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa bye brag tu kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gtan la dbab pa la/ rtsa bshad/ bzhugs tshul/ mdo rgyas/ gzhung tshad bstan pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud gnyis/ dang po ni/ dges rdor rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum lnga ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud dang / thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud gnyis/ dang po ni/ thun mong min pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhan yang thun mong bshad rgyud saṃ pu ṭa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa bzhugs tshul ni/ rtsa bshad rnam gsum gang zag bzhugs rim dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ /gsum pa mdo rgyas ni/ rtsa rgyud gleng gzhi'i mdor bstan dang pos rgyas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis bstan/ bzhi pa gzhung tshad ni/ rtsa rgyud tshigs bcad bdun brgya lnga bcu ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gsum pa rgyud sde rnams kyi tshad bstan pa ni/

tshul chen sngags kyi theg pa bsam yas kyang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa gsang sngags theg pa'i byung tshul la/ gzhan lugs dgag pa dang / rang lugs theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dod pa bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ji snyed pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dod pa bshad pa la/ ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i dus/ sangs rgyas pa'i gnas/ ji ltar sangs rgyas pa'i tshul/ mdzad pa'i gtso bo chos 'khor bskor tshul/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa'i tshul/ bye brag mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams su sprul pa'i sangs rgyas byon pa'i dus sogs bstan pa dang drug dang po ni/ skyon med bla ma rnams kyi bzhed srol ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa gnas ni/ de yi gnas ni stug po bkod pa ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu dgus bstan/ /gsum pa ji ltar sangs rgyas pa'i tshul la/ phyi'i mngon byang ltar bgrod pa dang / nang gi mngon byang ltar bgrod pa gnyis/ dang po la/ ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshul dngos dang / des sku gsum dbyer med du grub pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ gnas der rgyal sras mi g.yo'i bsam gtan la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar mngon byang thog mtha' chos sku dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa nang gi mngon byang ltar bgrod pa ni/ phyi yi mngon byang bgrod dang lhan cig tu/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ bzhi pa mdzad pa'i gtso bo chos 'khor bskor tshul la/ /nges don mi 'gyur ba'i chos 'khor bskor tshul dang / so so'i gnas su so so'i gdul bya la sprul pa mchog gis chos 'khor bskor tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'og min gnas der ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/

longs sku 'og min gnas las mi bskyod kyang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ lnga pa spyir sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar ston pa longs sku gcig pu de'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ drug pa bye brag tu mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams su sprul pa'i sangs rgyas byon pa'i dus su bstan pa la/ sprul sku ji ltar byon tshul/ de la 'khor ji ltar byung tshul/ chos kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskor tshul/ bka' ji ltar bsdus tshul/ mi rnams la ji ltar 'phel tshul dang lnga/ dang po ni/ khyad par sprul pa'i sangs rgyas zas gtsang sras/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la skal ldan gyi 'khor ji ltar byung tshul dang / 'khor gyi gtso bo sdud pa po ji ltar byung tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yi 'khor du gnas pa'i rigs can gsum/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ khyad par 'khor gyi gtso bo sdud pa po/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyi bstan/ gsum pa chos 'khor ji ltar bskor tshul la/ thun mong kyi chos 'khor bskor tshul dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje theg pa bskor tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ gzhan gyi log rtog dgag pa dang / rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rigs can gsum la chos 'khor rim pa gsum/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi bkod pa bsam yas kyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje theg pa bskor tshul la/ bskor tshul dngos dang / de la 'gal ba spang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsang rgyud mtha' dag grub pa'i gdul bya la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ dus la 'gal ba spang ba dang / ston pa la 'gal ba spang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gal te thub pa'i gong du sngags kyi lam/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'on kyang ston pa'i ye shes gcig yin phyir/

/zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa bka' ji ltar bsdu tshul la/ zhar byung nyan thos kyi bka' bsdu tshul/ theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i bka' ji ltar bsdus tshul/ gsang sngags kyi bka' ji ltar bsdus tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan la bsdu ba rnam gsum las/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin theg pa chen po'i mdo rnams kyang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gsum pa la/ gzhan gyi log rtog dgag pa dang / rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khyad par sngags kyi tshul rnams bsdus pa'i tshul/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ skyon med bka' dang bstan bcos dgongs pa ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gsum gyis bstan/ lnga pa mi rnams la ji ltar 'phel tshul ni/ de rjes klu las gyur ba'i dpa' bo dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gsum pa mjug bsdus ni/ 'dir smras pa/ rnam gzhag gong ma'i bzhed gzhung ji bzhin du/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa skabs kyi mtshan smos pa ni/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa'i don bsdus pa ste rim par phye ba dang po'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa mtshan gyi don la/ mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba/ don dngos/ dge ba bsngo ba/ skabs kyi mtshan smos pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ mtshan dpe rgyan gyi mnga' mdangs rab gsal ba'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la brjod bya don gyi rgyud dang / rjod byed tshig gi rgyud gnyis/ dang po la/ spyir rgyud ces bya ba gang yin pa dang / de la gsum du dbye ba/ gsum po so so'i nges tshig gsum po thabs dang shes rab la sogs par bzhag pa/ rgyal po la sogs par bzhag pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ rang sems gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /ces sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum ngo bo dbyer med kyang /

/zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa la rgyu rgyud kyi nges tshig thabs rgyud kyi nges tshig 'bras rgyud kyi nges tshig dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gdod nas spros bral dri bcas rang gi sems/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyu de 'bras bur 'byin byed rkyen gyi chos/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ thabs des glo bur dri ma kun sbyangs nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa gsum po thabs shes sogs su bzhag pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu kyai rdo rje'i mtshan don gnyis/ dang po ni/ bye brag so so'i rgyud kyi mtshan rnams kun/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ khyad par dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud rnams ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang dgus bstan/ lnga pa rgyal po sogs su bzhag pa la/ dngos dang / de bzhin bshad rgyud gnyis la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu rgyud rang bzhin rtog pas mi rdzi zhing / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin yang dag sbyor ba'ang 'bras bu'i mtshan/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang dgus bstan/ gnyis pa rjod byed tshig gi rgyud la dngos dang / de las byung ba'i dgos 'grel gnyis/ dang po la/ thun mong la grags pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa la grags pa gnyis/ dang po la rjod byed mtshan nyid pa dang / btags pa ba dang / de la rtsod pa spang ba gsum/ dang po ni/ brjod bya rgyud gsum ston pa'i rjod byed kyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ sgra rgyud blo la gnas pa'i 'bras bu dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ ming tshig yi ge gzugs sam 'du byed du/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la grags pa ni/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i 'khor gyi byang sems kyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa de las byung ba'i dgos 'grel ni/

brjod bya gnyis med ye shes don gyi rgyud/ /ces sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gsum pa dge ba bsngo ba ni/ 'dir smras pa/ rgyu rgyud thos bsam bsgom pa'i yul gyi mchog /ces sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa skabs kyi ming smos pa ni/ rgyud kyi mtshan don bshad pa'i skabs kyi don bsdus pa ste rim par phye ba gnyis pa'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag la/ mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba/ don dngos/ mjug dge ba bsngo ba/ skabs kyi ming smos pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ gsang gsum dbyer med mgon la phyag bgyis te/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ bshad thabs kyi rnam grangs dang / de la rtsod pa spang ba gnyis/ dang po la/ 'chad pa po 'chad sla zhing nyan pa po rtogs sla ba'i phyir gdams ngag drug gi bshad pa/ sems kyi rgyud rgyun chags gcig gtan la dbab pa la dgongs nas rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa dang / dbang lam du bya ba'i phyir bdag nyid can gsum gyi bshad pa/ 'bras bu sku bzhi lam du bya ba'i phyir gnas pa bzhi'i bshad pa/ spang bya mi mthun phyogs spong ba la dgongs nas dag pa gsum gyi bshad pa/ snod ma yin pa la gab cing gsang ba'i don du gsang ba bdun gyi bshad pa dang drug dang po la mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bshad bya spyi dang sbas pa mthar thug gsum/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa la bshad thabs dngos dang / des rgyud ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la bshad bya'i yan lag dang / 'chad byed kyi yan lag gnyis/ dang po la spyi don bshad pa/ sbas don du bshad pa/ mthar thug gi don du bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la pha rol tu phyin pa dang spyi don du bshad pa dang / bskyed pa'i rim pa dang spyi don du bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyi zhes bya ba gnyis ka'i thun mong ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/

smin byed bum pa'i dbang dang rjes 'brel ba'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ gnyis pa sbas don du bshad pa la/ rang byin rlabs dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbas pa zhes bya de la ma grags pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ thabs dang shes rab rdo rje padma dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gsum pa mthar thug gi don du bshad pa ni/ mthar thug ces pa lam de'i 'bras bu ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcus bstan/ gnyis pa 'chad byed kyi yan lag la/ dngos dang bshad thabs kyi rnam grangs gnyis/ dang po la/ yan lag gi don gyi bshad pa/ yi ge'i don gyi bshad/ man ngag gi don gyi bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dngos bstan ming dang tshig gi rjes 'brang nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang nyer drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar bshad kyang gzhung don mi rnyed pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bco brgyad kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ yan lag yi ge gnyis kas rtogs min pa'i/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ gnyis pa bshad thabs kyi rnam grangs ni/ spyi sbas mthar thug rim bzhin yan lag gi /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa des rgyud ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul la/ so sor bshad pa dang / ldan par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ brjod bya spyi sbas mthar thug rnam pa gsum/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ zab cing rgya che ston pa'i gzhung tshig 'ga'/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa la/ bshad thabs dngos dang / des rgyud ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang bzhin rnam dag phung khams skye mched rnams/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ bshad thabs 'dis kyang khre 'ur 'chad pa dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gsum pa bdag nyid can gsum gyi bshad pa la/ bshad thabs dngos dang / des rgyud ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis/

dang po ni/ lus dang bum dbang sprul sku dbyibs bdag nyid/ zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir yang bdag nyid can gsum khre 'u dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa gnas pa bzhi'i bshad pa la/ bshad thabs dngos dang / des rgyud ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'bras bu longs sku sbyang gzhi nying mtshams sbyor/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'chad tshul 'di la'ang gnas pa rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ lnga pa dag pa gsum gyi bshad pa la/ bshad thabs dngos dang / des rgyud ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos kun gdod nas ma skyes de bzhin nyid/ /ces sogs tshig rkang bcu gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir yang dag pa rnam gsum gzhung gi tshig /ces sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstan/ drug pa gsang ba bdun gyi bshad pa la/ bshad thabs dngos dang / des rgyud ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsang ba mi gsal de nyid mdor bstan dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir ni gzhung kun khre 'ur 'chad pa las/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gnyis pa rtsod pa spang ba la/ bshad thabs mang po don med du thal ba spang ba/ bshad yams gcig tu bshad pas tshogs pa la bshad par thal ba spang ba/ bshad thabs mang po gzhan gyi bshad tshul du thal ba spang ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gzhung tshig gcig la spyi sbas mthar thug sogs/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhung tshig khri 'ur bshad pa'i 'chad tshul des/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ 'phags skor la grags rgyan bdun zhes bshad pa/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan/ gsum pa dge ba bsngo ba ni/ 'dir smras pa/ 'chad bya 'chad byed phyogs res ma khengs par/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis bstan/ bzhi pa skabs kyi ming smos pa ni/ rgyud kyi bshad thabs kyi man ngag gi skabs kyi don bsdus pa ste rim par phye ba gsum pa'o/

/zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa mjug gi don ni/ swasti pra dzā bhyaḥrgyud sde'i rnam gzhag mtshan don bshad thabs rnams/ /zhes pa nas/ phan bde'i snang ba yun du rgyas pa legs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de dag gis ni spyir gzhung don 'chad pa'i tshul la/ dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don/ mtshams sbyar/ brgal lan dang lnga yod pa'i nang nas/ bsdus don gyi sgo nas gzhung 'chad tshul bstan pa yin la/ de la yang gzhung spyi'i bsdus don dang / gzhung so so'i bsdus don gnyis las/ 'dir bshad pa ni phyi ma yin te/ gzhung gi dbu zhabs ma lus pa'i don bsdus pa'i sgo nas khog phub pa ni gzhung so so'i bsdus don dang / gzhung spyi'i lugs rnam par bzhag pa tsam ni gzhung spyi'i bsdus don yin pas so/ /de skad du chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo las/ bsdus pa'i don la rnam gnyis te/ /ngag don bsdus te bstan pa dang / /gzhung don so so'i bsdus don ni/ /don 'dus tshig gsal brjod pa bde/ /ngag nyung tshig snyom gzung ba sla/ /bsdus don nyid kyis gzhung go ba/ /de 'dra gang gis shes de mkhas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag mtshan don bshad thabs rnams/ /legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos chen po yi/ /bsdus don 'chad byed khog phub don 'grel 'di/ /blo gsal dga' byed pad dkar phreng mdzes yin/ 1 /'di ni skyes sbyangs blo yi mig gsal zhing / /yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan gyis bskyangs pas/ /dus mthar skyes kyang sngon gyi dam pa yi/ /rnam thar 'dzin pa gang des legs par sbyar/ 2 /deng dus kho bo'i rjes 'jug blo gsal rnams/ /lto chos phra mos sngags par ma rlom par/ /bsdus don don 'grel gru chen 'di bsten nas/ /gong ma'i gsung rab rgya mtshor 'jug par rigs/ 3 /dang por bsdus don nyid la legs par sbyangs/ /bar du khog phub don 'grel 'di bslabs nas/

/tha mar gong ma'i gsung rab legs bltas na/ /rnam gzhag mtshan don bshad thabs kun shes 'gyur/ 4 /'di brtsams dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /bstan pa cher rgyas don gnyis mthar phyin te/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs kyi gsung rab rgyud sde spyi rnam chen mo'i bsdus don tshul gsum gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan gyi khob phub don 'grel pad dkar phreng mdzes zhes bya ba 'di ni grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer ma mchis pa rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can rnams kyi zhabs sen dbang gi rgyal po spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod pa shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab rnams la yun ring mo nas 'dris par byas shing / lhag par rgyud sde spyi rnam dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la zhib tu dpyad cing / tshul gsum gsal rgyan nyid la rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bshad pa gnang ba'i zin bris thor bu 'dug pa rnams la gzhi byas te rang gi slob ma rnam dpyod dang ldan zhing / rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la blo kha phyogs pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa kho nas/ rgya gar lugs la/ tu ti rorgā ri zhes grags shing / rgya nag lugs la chu mo phag gi lo/ bha tro zhes pa'i zla ba'i dmar cha rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes la/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang gi nyi 'od 'khyil par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shabs stod pa bkra shis don 'grub kyis bgyis pa 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma dang mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzad nas bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

/sarba maṅga laṃ// rgyud kyi sngon 'gro tshul gsum gsal ba'i rgyan/ /'chad nyan bya tshul legs bshad thur ma 'di/ /bzung bas kun la spyan dbye'i cho ga grub/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu mngon sum 'dir byon bzhin/ /zhes pa wa gi shwa ra dharmā kirti rjes su yi rang zhing bsngags pa dang bcas pa'i gtam mo// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 14 a myes zhabs/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa'i bsdus don tshul gsum gsal rgyan zhes bya ba'i khog phub don 'grel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
